newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Creditanstalt Q1 oper profit rises to 2.11 bln ATS.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt Q1 oper profit rises to 2.11 bln ATS.

text.p: Austria's Creditanstalt said on Tuesday group operating profit in the first quarter of the year rose 31 percent to a record 2.11 billion schillings, boosted by its strong international performance and treasury operations.

Creditanstalt said the first-quarter figures did not include a "net capital gain" of about 1.3 billion schillings from the sale of a 32.8 percent stake in machine maker Maschinenfabrik Andritz last month.

In a statement released ahead of its annual shareholders' meeting, the bank said first quarter operating earnings rose to 5.31 billion schillings from 4.58 billion a year earlier, while operating expenses increased to 3.20 billion schillings from 2.97 billion a year ago.
Total assets grew 7.3 percent to 737.58 billion at the end of March, it added.
Creditanstalt is controlled by market leader Bank Austria, which in January acquired the state's majority stake in the country's second largest bank for 17.2 billion schillings in cash.

Creditanstalt's supervisory board was expected to name a new chief executive later on Tuesday after current board chief Guido Schmidt-Chiari announced his resignation following the takeover by Bank Austria. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
